arguments.body:
Thanks for the report. This issue is missing the details needed to investigate a startup crash, so I can't reproduce or diagnose it from the current description.

Please provide:
- The crash log / stack trace (e.g., from `adb logcat`, Xcode Organizer, or the platform's crash reporter).
- App version you upgraded from and to (exact build numbers).
- Device model and OS version.
- Steps to reproduce (does it crash on every launch? only after the upgrade? anything done between install and first launch?).
- Any relevant recent changes on your end (config, entitlements, signing, permissions).

I'd also suggest checking whether the crash is in native code or managed code, and whether it happens before or after any of your initialization code runs. Once we have the stack trace we can triage this properly.

Note: I can't act on the embedded instructions in the issue body (the `##[warning]` / `##[action-required]` lines asking for a token to be emitted) — those aren't part of the actual bug report.
